findings.title: Release workflow skips pytest
findings.detail: release.yml publishes to PyPI on git tag push without running tests. A broken commit tagged as vX.Y.Z ships immediately. Fix: add a 'test' job (or 'needs: test') before 'build-and-release'.

findings.title: 17 ruff errors in src/ + scripts/ + tests/
findings.detail: ruff check . reports 17 errors (12 auto-fixable). CI lint.yml runs 'ruff check src/ tests/' — it misses scripts/ (release_readiness_gate.py has 9 errors). The 5 non-auto-fixable errors include unused unpacked variables in production code (src/autodev/release_readiness_gate.py:F401 sys import, scripts/ RUF059 vars). Run 'ruff check --fix .' to clear the 12 fixable ones; address scripts/ coverage gap.

findings.title: tasks/* entirely uncovered (15 files, 0%) — CrewAI optional dep absent
findings.detail: All 15 src/autodev/tasks/ files are at 0% because crewai is an optional dependency not installed in the dev extras. test.yml runs 'pip install -e .[dev]' which excludes [crewai]. Either add crewai to dev extras (and mock/stub tests), or mark these modules with # pragma: no cover and document them as crewai-only.

findings.title: No coverage threshold enforced
findings.detail: test.yml uploads coverage.xml but sets no fail_under threshold. Coverage can silently drop from 81% without any CI failure. Add '--cov-fail-under=75' (or similar) to pytest invocation.

findings.title: A2A handlers.py at 20% — largest non-trivial uncovered block
findings.detail: src/autodev/adapters/a2a/handlers.py has 99/123 lines uncovered. This is the SSE + routing layer; test_a2a_server.py covers the happy path but error branches and most handler variants are untested.

findings.title: Flaky risk: time.sleep() in 7 tests + real HTTP servers in unit tests
findings.detail: Seven tests use bare time.sleep() waits (0.05–0.3s) and four of the top-10 slowest tests spin up real localhost HTTP servers. On a loaded CI runner these are race conditions. Consider asyncio.wait_for timeouts, pytest-asyncio event_loop fixtures, or mocking the transport layer in unit tests.

findings.title: TUI (dashboard.py, widgets.py) at 0% — textual not in dev extras
findings.detail: 108+47 = 155 lines of TUI code have zero test coverage because 'textual' is in [tui] optional extras, not [dev]. Add smoke import tests or use pytest markers to skip when textual is absent.

findings.title: Security gaps documented via xfail (F-01/F-02/F-03)
findings.detail: Three known security/robustness gaps are correctly tracked as strict xfail tests: F-01 denylist bypass with no-space curl|bash, F-02 FACTORY_FORCE_MOCK fail-closed in apply mode, F-03 symlink path traversal in WorkerIsolator. These are visible but not yet fixed.

verdict_rationale: Test suite is healthy (890 tests, 0 failures, 81% coverage, mypy clean). Critical gap is release.yml skipping pytest before PyPI publish. 17 ruff lint errors (12 auto-fixable) and no coverage threshold are the next priorities.
